name: fork-and-flush
description: Explore competing solutions in fresh agent sessions and continue the best verified lineage within a fixed budget.

interface.longDescription:
A portable workflow for bounded research and engineering experiments. Start from a scored baseline, explore competing solutions in isolated workspaces with fresh agent conversations, evaluate saved candidates, and continue the best verified lineage.

Supply a task, an evaluator, permitted files, and a budget. Execution requires a host that supports fresh sessions, isolated workspaces, stopping limits, and session continuation. If these capabilities are unavailable, the skill explains the gap and provides a plan. Installing it does not provide a scheduler or grant permissions.

Includes a local budget planner and runtime guidance. Independent adaptation of Microsoft Research's Fork-and-Flush method; no affiliation or endorsement. Workflow tests do not reproduce the paper's benchmark gains or establish an advantage over a matched single-agent run.
defaultPrompt: Plan a fork-and-flush experiment for my task. Identify the evaluator, runtime capabilities, and budget needed.
Use fork-and-flush to compare implementations within my budget and preserve the best verified result.
